title: Manufacturer Copay Card Terms — Minimum Patient Pay on Reimbursed Fills (Savings & Copay Assistance Programs)
content:
**Clause.** The reimbursement minimum pay on a Manufacturer Copay Card reimbursement of the Savings & Copay Assistance Programs follows the size of the claim's patient pay: a patient pay of **1000.00 dollars or more** keeps **10.00 dollars** with the patient, **500.00 to 999.99 dollars** keeps **7.50 dollars**, and a smaller patient pay keeps the program's patient minimum pay.

The claim's patient pay is the patient pay on the paid insurance claim for the fill being reimbursed, as Prescription Insurance on File records it.

| Claim patient pay | Kept with the patient |
|---|---|
| $1000.00 or more | $10.00 |
| $500.00 to $999.99 | $7.50 |
| below $500.00 | the program's patient minimum pay |

**Hypothetical edges.** A patient pay of $999.99 keeps $7.50; $1000.00 keeps $10.00; $499.99 keeps the program's patient minimum pay; $500.00 keeps $7.50.
